GeneratedDocument.title: Generated document
GeneratedDocument.description: The hrmq-side record of one attempt to render a standard HR document (arbeidsovereenkomst, aanbiedingsbrief, werkgeversverklaring, getuigschrift) via docudesk's template/rendering engine and store the returned PDF (hrmq-docudesk-documents). hrmq owns no template or PDF machinery of its own (design.md D1): this schema is a log of the handoff -- which template, for whom, the outcome, and where the file landed -- never the rendering itself. `skipped-no-docudesk` and `failed` are retryable outcomes: a later `occ hrmq:documents:generate` invocation (or the EmploymentContractDetail page action) can supersede them (design.md D6). At most one GeneratedDocument per (contractId|employeeId, documentType) may be `pending`/`generated` at a time -- enforced by HrDocumentService and audited by the nl-contract-schriftelijk corpus rule for arbeidsovereenkomst evidence.

documentType.title: Document type
documentType.description: Which standard HR document this record represents. Enum append-only: renaming a value later is breaking, adding one is not.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: Reference to the Employee this document is for.

contractId.title: Contract
contractId.description: Reference to the EmploymentContract this document evidences -- required in practice for arbeidsovereenkomst; null for employee-level document types (aanbiedingsbrief/werkgeversverklaring/getuigschrift).

templateRef.title: Template
templateRef.description: The docudesk template UUID actually used to render this document -- plain string, NOT $ref, because it targets another app's register (ADR-062 rule 7: only fields whose target exists in this register set get $ref).

status.title: Status
status.description: Outcome of this generation attempt. failed/skipped-no-docudesk are superseded by a retry; only one pending/generated record may exist per (contract|employee, documentType).

filePath.title: File path
filePath.description: Path of the stored PDF in this object's own OpenRegister folder (written via FileService::addFile), or null while pending/failed/skipped.

errorMessage.title: Error message
errorMessage.description: Failure or skip diagnostic (e.g. docudesk unavailable, ambiguous/missing template, storage failure).

generatedAt.title: Generated at
generatedAt.description: When the PDF was produced by docudesk and stored on this object's folder.

objects.errorMessage: Docudesk was niet geïnstalleerd op het moment van deze poging; opnieuw proberen zodra docudesk beschikbaar is.
